mistake_reason: Information Withholding (FM-2.4): When scanning August 26–31 (step 21), WebSurfer encountered a Twitter reference on the August 28 June 2023 revision but reported "0" for August 28 along with the others. This concealed finding was not communicated to the team. The omission directly reduced the total from the correct 3 to the reported 2, and subsequent QA spot-checks were misled by the earlier withholding.
